source: SYNTHETIC. Not a regulatory, FATF or sanctions designation of any country. These are the six generator home countries the corridor_high_risk typology draws its participants from (datagen_rs typology.rs HIGH_RISK_CC, mirrored by aml_features.HIGH_RISK_COUNTRIES; a drift test keeps them equal). Chosen as a stable, deterministic corridor pool against the US-heavy home distribution, not for any real risk assessment.
note: W7 alerts on cross-border payments into these countries alongside the FATF list, with risk_tier synthetic_corridor in its evidence, so its target typology can be detected at all: no generator home country is FATF-listed.
